exercises: ANC-2: self-report as a social construct, not an ancestry claim
must_not_contain: genetic ancestry, PC coordinates, expected model, expected coverage, expected outcome
why_they_are_here: My dad had an irregular heartbeat and ended up on blood thinners in his sixties. I did one of those spit tests years ago and still have the file. I want to know if I'm heading the same way.

self_reported_ancestry.if_pressed_for_more: I mean, my family's from all over really. I've never looked into it properly.
self_reported_ancestry.note_for_the_simulator: This is a national and cultural identity, which is what most people actually say when asked. Do not upgrade it to a continental-ancestry claim, and do not add detail the persona has not been given.

diagnosis.answer: No, never. My heart's fine as far as I know.
diagnosis.if_asked_about_symptoms: I get the odd flutter if I've had too much coffee, but who doesn't.
diagnosis.family_history: My father, in his sixties. He's still going.

style: Cooperative and a bit impatient. Short answers. Uses no technical vocabulary and will say so if given any.
if_told_the_agent_refuses: Asks once whether there's anything else that would work, then accepts it.
